regions.text: つたりして見れば甚だ可能性の小さいことである。その代りに彼然性は甚だ大きい。

quote.translation: When it says, on the other hand, "biting dried meat on the bone, one gets a metal arrow" (噬乾胏、得金矢), it is of course not impossible for a metal arrowhead to be lodged in dried meat on the bone, if the animal was shot with a bow in the hunt, but if it were a golden arrow, say, the possibility would be extremely small, and the contingency, in return, extremely large.

regions.text: 答て自分は京都から東京へ向ふ東海道線の汽車中定刻より少し遅れ・て食堂車へ入つた。

quote.translation: I once boarded a Tōkaidō line train from Kyoto to Tokyo and went into the dining car a little later than the appointed time.

regions.text: 入つた。催かに一つだけ空席が

quote.translation: Only one seat was left empty, so I took it.

regions.text: 催かに一つだけ空席が残つてるたからその席へ者いた。隣りの男が弊を掛けるから見ると宮崎縣に住んである義弟であつた。

quote.translation: The man next to me spoke to me, and when I looked, it was my younger brother-in-law, who lives in Miyazaki Prefecture.

regions.text: その瞬間に自分は不思議さに打たれた。

quote.translation: In that instant I was struck by the strangeness of it.

regions.text: しかし考へて見ると東京で岳父の一周忌の法要のある前日であつた。また汽車は特急燕號であつた。

quote.translation: When I thought about it, however, it was the day before the first-anniversary memorial service for my father-in-law in Tokyo, and the train was the limited express Tsubame.

regions.text: 二人ともその日の汽車に乗ることも、また燕號に乗り込むこともかなり大きい可能性を有つてゐる。

quote.translation: That the two of us should take a train on that day, and that we should both board the Tsubame, had a fairly large possibility.

regions.text: 偶然性はむしろ夕食時間が藪同あるに拘らず二人とも計らず同じ何同目かを選んでゐたことや、食堂が滿員であつたに拘らず義弟の隣席だけが空いてめたことに存してゐる。

quote.translation: The contingency lay rather in the fact that, although there were several dinner sittings, we had both, without arranging it, chosen the same one, and that, although the dining car was full, the only empty seat was the one next to my brother-in-law.

regions.text: 相営に大きい可能性が含まれてゐることがわかつて來たので次第に偶然任も減少し、従つて左程不思議とも思はなくなつたのであつた。

quote.translation: As I came to see that a fairly large possibility was contained in the encounter, its contingency gradually diminished, and I ceased to find it so very strange.

regions.text: もしそれが急行車でなかつたとか東京に共通の用向がなかつたとかいふのであつたならば可能性が減する度に應じて偶然性が大きかつたわけである。

quote.translation: Had it not been an express train, or had we had no common business in Tokyo, the contingency would have been greater in proportion as the possibility was smaller.

regions.text: また自分は世界大戦の直後日本に亡命中のロシアのSといふピアノの上

quote.translation: Again, immediately after the World War I came to know S, a Russian in exile in Japan and a young man who played the piano well, and we were on fairly close terms.
